text.title: Purchase order lines against supplier invoices

records.name: Corner boards
records.reason: Invoiced at 3.45 each. The order and the contract both say 3.10.

records.name: Strapping kits
records.reason: Invoiced for 66. The goods receipt shows 60 delivered.

records.name: Tape 48 mm
records.reason: Invoice TS-20418 arrived twice, by post and by email. Pay it once.

records.name: Label rolls
records.reason: Delivered on 19 March. No invoice yet, so the cost needs an accrual.

records.name: Cartons 60 x 40
records.reason: Unit price rounded differently. 1.50 under, inside tolerance.

records.name: Dividers
records.reason: The supplier used the old price list.

records.name: Foam inserts
records.reason: Short shipment. The other 100 are on back order.

records.name: Freight surcharge
records.reason: No order line covers this charge. Ask the supplier what it is for.

records.name: Banner stands
records.reason: A rush fee was folded into the unit price instead of billed separately.

records.name: Catalogues
records.reason: Rounding on the invoice. 0.90 over, inside tolerance.

records.name: Proof charges
records.reason: No order line covers this charge.
